instructions: These eight cases check that the INTEGRATED deployed product matches the finished science. They are not a request to redo published scientific research. All results are currently unverified against the new frontend/backend repo.

cases.title: Same length, different rate: I-1 vs II-5
cases.steps: Open Compare Runs and select I-1 and II-5. Switch from flame length to spread rate.
cases.expected: 4 vs 4 cm flame length; 0.18 vs 0.21 cm/s spread; +0.03 (+16.67%); confounding warning and Olson source.

cases.title: Same length, different rate: III-1 vs II-6
cases.expected: 5 vs 5 cm flame length; 0.23 vs 0.26 cm/s spread; +0.03 (+13.04%); source conflict for PSI-100 airflow is visible.

cases.title: Confinement contrast: I-1 vs IV-SIBAL
cases.expected: 0.18 vs 0.36 cm/s (+100%); duct heights 51 vs 30.5 cm; oxygen 21.7 vs 23.1%; no assertion that duct alone caused the difference.

cases.title: Missing factorial cell
cases.steps: Open Research Gaps or Scale Transfer Lab 2×2.
cases.expected: Narrow 5 cm × shallow 30.5 cm historical configuration missing; existing cells labeled historical analogs, not controlled replications; interaction estimate null.

cases.title: PSI-100 source conflict from dataset
cases.steps: Open III-1 conflict detail and inspect source metadata.
cases.expected: Olson 25 cm/s and PSI-100 candidate S1 30 cm/s shown separately; no silent 25 or 30 override; source_conflicts.json drives output.

cases.title: IV-SIBAL candidate IV-1 alias from dataset
cases.expected: Match marked probable/not confirmed; digitized ~0.368 vs table 0.36 not double-counted as independent burns.

cases.title: NASA prediction refusal and synthetic isolation
cases.steps: Request an unseen scenario or open model-prediction state.
cases.expected: prediction_status VALIDATION_NOT_SUPPORTED, prediction_cm_s null. Synthetic estimates labeled synthetic; not rendered as NASA predictions.

cases.title: Brand, offline assistant and deployed paths
cases.steps: Check hero, open Ask 1gnition, refresh all four views from a deployed URL.
cases.expected: ZERO GUESSING. ZERO HIDDEN UNCERTAINTY. followed by 1gnition; Ask clearly says offline rule-based; source JS/JSON endpoints load publicly; no dead API dependencies.
